info.title: How does &trento; improve monitoring and validation?

abstract.para: Learn about &trento;, included in &sles4sap;, which helps you monitor and validate &sap; landscape.

topic.para: &trento; automatically discovers servers, &hana; databases, &s4hana; and &netweaver; applications and clusters. It validates your setup against &suse; and &sap; best practices and monitors overall system health. The information can then be accessed through the &trento; Web console.

For day-2 operations, &trento; provides built-in automation for managing hosts, clusters, and &sap; systems. These operations are protected by user permissions and include internal guardrails to prevent configuration mistakes.

Additionally, &trento; connects to an AI assistant through the &trento; &mcp; server. This integration allows you to generate reports on the monitoring and compliance data collected from your &sap; infrastructure, which includes host metrics collected by &sap; host exporters. As a technology preview, the AI assistant can also help identify root causes and troubleshoot system issues.
